gallery.title: File:Giraffes at Nsele Park in Kinshasa, DR Congo.jpg
gallery.source: Giraffes at Nsele Park in Kinshasa, DR Congo
gallery.description: A group of zebras at Parc de la Vallée de la Nsele, the largest city park in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. As you stroll through the park's well-maintained pathways, you may catch a glimpse of these elegant giants gracefully grazing on the foliage, their gentle movements captivating the attention of onlookers.

gallery.filename: Nsele Valley Park, Kinshasa, DR Congo.jpg
gallery.title: File:Nsele Valley Park, Kinshasa, DR Congo.jpg
gallery.source: Nsele Valley Park, Kinshasa, DR Congo
gallery.description: I visited the Parc de la Vallée de la Nsele in October 2021 and took a lot of pictures. As you stroll through the park's well-maintained pathways, you may catch a glimpse of these elegant giants gracefully grazing on the foliage, their gentle movements captivating the attention of onlookers. The park's commitment to conservation and wildlife preservation ensures that the buffaloes have a natural and protected habitat to call their own.

gallery.filename: A view of Congo River from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).jpg
gallery.title: File:A view of Congo River from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).jpg
gallery.source: A view of Congo River from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC)
gallery.description: The Congo River is the second-longest river in Africa, and its beauty is truly awe-inspiring. The view of the river from Kinshasa, the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is particularly stunning. The river winds its way through the lush green landscape, surrounded by towering trees and vibrant wildlife.

gallery.title: File:Herman Kande.jpg
gallery.description: Herman Kande, born on January 21, 1994, in Kinshasa, is a multifaceted artist known for his powerful contributions to gospel music, songwriting, and visual arts. He is the son of Pastor Daniel Kande and Prophetess Celestine Mbiya, who instilled in him a deep-rooted faith and passion for artistic expression from an early age.
